company_profile: Unum Ireland runs the Unum Technology Centre in Carlow, building software and AI solutions for Unum, a US provider of income protection insurance.
title: Senior AI Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years delivering production AI and ML solutions across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs and ships Generative AI applications, including LangGraph multi-agent systems, RAG knowledge assistants and document-extraction agents, backed by LLMOps practice: automated evaluation, tracing, monitoring and versioning. Builds the APIs and services around them with Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform, working closely with business stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Insurance Claims Document Assistant
bullets: Built a RAG and agent-based assistant for insurance claim and policy documents, extracting fields with Amazon Textract and answering questions over a vector index through Claude on AWS Bedrock.
Evaluated answers with LLM evaluators and tracing, versioned prompts and models in MLflow, and deployed the FastAPI service in Docker on Amazon ECS through Terraform and CI/CD.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior AI Engineer role at the Unum Technology Centre. For the past year I have built production GenAI in healthcare: an extraction agent for lab documents, a multi-agent analytics chatbot, and the evaluation pipelines that keep them honest. The common thread is taking AI from a promising prototype to something a business relies on.

Income protection is something people depend on at hard moments, and AI that helps that work run accurately is worth building carefully. My reason for Carlow is also personal: my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Carlow together and settle there long term. A centre that offers room to grow in one place suits that plan.

I would bring hands-on experience with the architectures on your list. In telecom I built a RAG assistant in LangGraph that reached a 90% match rate against existing solutions, and my current evaluation and tracing pipelines cut human review by 43%. AWS Bedrock and SageMaker are where I would ramp up fastest, building on my GCP and Azure work.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building for teachers and children has made me careful about reliability and about how people actually use what I ship. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
